svg.title: How I work — product first; divide and conquer with shared services; AI-native workflow with Claude Code and HANDOFF.md
svg.desc: Three cards describing how Harsh works.
svg.text: Own the product. Share the backbone. Ship with AI.

g.text: I own the product and the architecture
and direct the build: spec, build, ship,
Auth, signing, storage and payments are
built once as shared services. Each
product carries only what sets it apart.
Claude Code is the primary implementer.
Every major session ends with a
HANDOFF.md so the next one starts warm.
